 "content": "from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The objects are solid rectangles in the source pattern; replace their bounding boxes,
    # removing distractor pixels embedded in them.
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if len(cells)<8: continue
        ys=[r for r,c in cells]; xs=[c for r,c in cells]
        y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        area=(y1-y0+1)*(x1-x0+1)
        if area >= 8 and len(cells)/area >= 0.65:
            for r in range(y0,y1+1):
                for c in range(x0,x1+1): out[r][c]=color
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__': pass
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
